title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-16
lineage: ? > C > CDR > EAC > CE Pro > CDWAV > FLAV (level 8)

ai_review.summary: Decent but not pristine audio captures a classic ’73 show with China>Rider, Bird Song, Playing in the Band and a Dark Star‑Truckin’ jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is serviceable – it isn’t crystal‑clear but conveys the intimate atmosphere of a 1973 concert. Musically the night shines thanks to an opening China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, soaring Bird Song, a powerful Playing in the Band and a sprawling Dark Star > Truckin' > Dew segment. Fans note the crowd’s respectful vibe, making it a noteworthy addition for completists despite the modest sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers praise the performance (high show weight) while noting only average sound quality; with limited data the rating reflects a strong show tempered by modest recording fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is okay but not great; some lack of clarity, though audience ambience and floor presence are audible.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with China>Rider, followed by a mix of melodic and exploratory jams that maintain momentum through Bird Song, Playing in the Band, and the extended Dark Star sequence.
